Hi Maya,

Good news — I've made a decision on the security setup. We're going with the Monitored Alarm Subscription.

I know the back door at night was your biggest worry, and this felt like the stronger option for that: every door and window gets a sensor, the siren goes off the moment anything opens, and if we're asleep or don't hear our phones, the monitoring center is notified and dispatches anyway. We don't have to be the ones watching.

It also covers us when we're traveling. Even if we miss an alert on our phones, the alarm company is still paying attention and can send help — so there's always someone checking the house, around the clock.

The trade-offs: we're giving up live camera views of the driveway, and we'll need to give the dog walker access through the keypad instead of temporary codes. There's also the three-year contract, but the professional installation means it's set up properly from day one, with nothing for me to maintain.

The quote is held through Friday, so I'll confirm with the installer tomorrow and get us on their schedule.

Love you — I think we'll both sleep easier with this one.
